<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Remade Home tab with key details, usage stats and quick access buttons

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Remade Control Character with walking, jumping, crouching and animations

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Remade Shaders and Sky sections

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Updated built-in shader presets

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Remade Particles section with more settings

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Remade ESP settings and Experimental section

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Reorganized Settings and Invincibility config sections

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Spawn Pallet is now Spawn Toy, with a toy selector [Keybinds]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Renamed Destroy Food to Break Holdable

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Break PCLD and Break All Holdables stop when turned off

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Smooth Click TP preserves animations and autorotation

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Improved PCLD detection and smoothing

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Improved Realistic Water generation with progress notifications

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Improved Explosions section

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Improved Anti Banana on high ping

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Faster Destroy Train

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Preserve House Time and Break Barrier use Invisible Teleportation

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Anti-Lag is enabled by default

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Target Kick holds one target directly above you and multiple targets in a circle

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Removed duplicate sounds from Sound Spam

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Fixed overlapping parts in Anti Network Ownership

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Fixed settings carrying over between independent Auto-Clicker targets

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Fixed Anti-kick resticking its toy without grabbing it first

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Fixed character freezing from Gucci Anti Grab and Remove Gucci

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Fixed Disable Void needing to be retoggled after deleting objects

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> New Anti-Lag method

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Anti Sticky-Exploits

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Streamer Mode

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Reanimation for Anti Grab and Anti Snowball

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Resolve Desync [Target]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Ragdoll Kill [Toy Effects]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Better Replication [Player]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Deletion and Breaking methods [Break Holdable, Break All Holdables]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Silent and Fast Grab & Drop methods [Anti Network Ownership]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Anti-kick toy selection, positioning, rotation and presets

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Only Grab Plot Toys [Toys Aura]

<font color="#7d55ff">•</font> Fix All button for decollided parts
